hints: Divide bonus by salary and express as a percentage to 3 significant figures.
walkthrough:
Calculate the bonus paid in year 24 using arithmetic progression with $a = 600, d = 100, n = 24$:
$$\text{Bonus}_{24} = 600 + (24 - 1)(100) = 600 + 23(100) = 2900$$

Calculate the basic salary in year 24 using geometric progression with $a = 30000, r = 1.03, n = 24$:
$$\text{Salary}_{24} = 30000 \times (1.03)^{24 - 1} = 30000 \times (1.03)^{23} \approx 30000 \times 1.973587 \approx 59207.60$$

Express the bonus as a percentage of the salary:
$$\text{Percentage} = \frac{2900}{59207.60} \times 100\% \approx 4.898\% \approx 4.90\% \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
